tours.title: Look at today's schedule
tours.q: How do I look at today's schedule?
tours.what: The schedule shows every visit for the day, one column per chair. Use it to see who is coming, who has arrived and where the gaps are. It opens on today.

steps.text: Press G then S: today’s schedule opens

tours.title: Find and open a patient's chart
tours.q: How do I find and open a patient's chart?
tours.what: The command bar finds any patient from any screen by name, phone number, birth date or chart number. Opening them makes them the active patient, so every other screen already knows who you are working on.

steps.text: Press Ctrl/⌘K: the command bar opens
Type the last name: they are the first match

t.css: input[placeholder="Find a patient (name, phone, birth date, chart #), a screen or an action…"]
t.label: Find a patient (name, phone, birth date,

steps.text: Press Enter: the chart opens

t.css: input[placeholder="Find a patient (name, phone, birth date, chart #), a screen or an action…"]
t.label: {last}

tours.title: Check a patient's alerts, balance, insurance and next visit at a glance
tours.q: How do I see a patient’s alerts, balance, insurance and next visit at a glance?
tours.what: Once a patient is the active patient, the patient bar across the top of every screen shows their medical and office alerts, what they owe, their insurance and their next visit. You don’t have to open anything.

steps.text: On any screen the patient bar shows alerts, balance, insurance and the next visit — nothing to click

tours.title: Reply to a patient's text
tours.q: How do I reply to a patient's text?
tours.what: Messages holds every text conversation with patients, newest first. Replying takes a few keys and the text goes out from the office number.

steps.text: Messages: the newest conversation is highlighted at the top
Press Enter: the conversation opens with the cursor in the reply box
Type the reply and press Enter: sent

expect.text: Of course! Tuesday at 10 or Thursday at 2?

tours.title: Chart a finding on a tooth ("30 MO caries")
tours.q: How do I chart a finding on a tooth?
tours.what: On the Chart tab you chart by typing, the way you would say it: the tooth, the surfaces and the finding. It shows what it will chart before you press Enter.

steps.text: On the chart, type 3: an entry box opens
Type "0 MO caries": the finding is shown as it will be charted
Press Enter: charted on the drawing (Undo shows)

tours.title: Open a patient's x-rays
tours.q: How do I open a patient's x-rays?
tours.what: X opens the patient’s newest x-ray set on its first image. The arrow keys step through the images.

steps.text: Press X: the newest x-ray set opens on its first image
Press →: the next image

tours.title: Text a patient
tours.q: How do I text a patient?
tours.what: Alt+T opens a text conversation with the active patient from any screen, with the cursor ready to type.

steps.text: Press Alt+T: their conversation opens with the cursor in the reply box
Type the text and press Enter: sent

tours.title: Switch the schedule between chairs, providers or one provider
tours.q: How do I switch the schedule between chairs, providers or one provider?
tours.what: The schedule can show one column per chair, one column per provider, or just one provider’s day.

steps.text: Press P: one column per provider
Press V: just one provider
Press C: back to one column per chair

tours.title: Check a patient in
tours.q: How do I check a patient in?
tours.what: Checking a patient in tells the back office they have arrived. The visit’s card changes colour for everyone.

steps.text: With the visit focused, press I: the patient is checked in

tours.title: Write a clinical note
tours.q: How do I write a clinical note?
tours.what: Alt+N opens today’s clinical note for the active patient, already drafted from the visit (the procedures and your template). Add what happened and save.

steps.text: Press Alt+N: the note opens drafted from today’s visit, cursor in the box
Type what happened
Press Ctrl/⌘+Enter: saved and linked to the visit

tours.title: Seat a patient
tours.q: How do I seat a patient?
tours.what: Seating the patient shows everyone that they are in the chair.

steps.text: Press S: the patient is seated

tours.title: Mark a visit finished (patient out)
tours.q: How do I mark a visit finished?
tours.what: Marking a visit “out” records that the patient is done in the chair. On a visit that is already finished, O opens its checkout instead.

steps.text: Press O: the visit is marked out (visit complete)

tours.title: Review medical history — no changes
tours.q: How do I review medical history — no changes?
tours.what: At each visit someone confirms the medical history. When nothing has changed, one key records “reviewed today, no changes” with your name.

steps.text: Press R: "reviewed today, no changes" is recorded

tours.title: Set today's procedures complete (post production)
tours.q: How do I set today’s procedures complete (post the charges)?
tours.what: When the work is done, completing today’s procedures posts their charges to the ledger and counts the production. Shift+C finds today’s planned work and asks once.

steps.text: Press Shift+C: a line asks to complete the 2 procedures and post the charges
Press Enter: completed, charges posted

tours.title: Confirm an appointment
tours.q: How do I confirm an appointment?
tours.what: Marks a visit as confirmed (by phone). Patients who reply C to a reminder text are confirmed automatically.

steps.text: With the visit selected, press C: confirmed by phone (Undo shows)

tours.title: Check a patient out (charges, payment, next visit)
tours.q: How do I check a patient out?
tours.what: Checkout collects what is due, books the next visit and marks the patient checked out, on one screen. The amount is already filled in with what they owe today plus any earlier balance.

steps.text: Press O on the finished visit: checkout opens with what’s due now (today’s share + any earlier balance) in the amount, focused
Press Enter on the first suggestion: next cleaning booked with their hygienist; "Mark checked out" takes the focus
Press Enter: checked out

tours.title: Mark a patient ready for the doctor
tours.q: How do I mark a patient ready for the doctor?
tours.what: Tells the dentist that the hygiene patient is ready for the exam. The card shows “Ready · Dr” for everyone.

steps.text: Press R: the card shows "ready for the doctor"

tours.title: Take a patient payment
tours.q: How do I take a patient payment?
tours.what: Alt+P opens the active patient’s ledger with the payment panel, the amount already set to what they owe. Enter posts it.

steps.text: Press Alt+P: the ledger opens with the payment panel; the amount is filled in with what they owe
Press Enter: posted with the method this person used last

tours.title: Book an appointment for an existing patient
tours.q: How do I book an appointment for an existing patient?
tours.what: Alt+B opens the booking form on the active patient’s next open time with their usual dentist or hygienist. Enter books it.

steps.text: Press Alt+B: the booking form opens on the patient’s next open time with their dentist
Press Enter: booked

tours.title: Chart planned treatment ("14 D2740")
tours.q: How do I chart planned treatment?
tours.what: Type a tooth and a procedure code on the Chart tab and the fee and the patient’s estimated share show before you press Enter.

steps.text: Type 1 on the chart: the entry box opens
Type "4 D2740": the crown, its fee and the patient’s estimate show
Press Enter: planned on #14

tours.title: Create and send an insurance claim
tours.q: How do I create and send an insurance claim?
tours.what: The patient’s Insurance tab shows finished work that hasn’t been billed yet. B makes the claim and sends it to the clearinghouse.

steps.text: Insurance tab: "Bill … claim" shows the finished work. Press B: the claim is made and sent

tours.title: Sign a clinical note
tours.q: How do I sign a clinical note?
tours.what: The dentist signs each note. A signed note is locked with the dentist’s name and NPI; later changes are addenda.

steps.text: Clinical notes: the unsigned note shows "Sign". Click it: signed with the dentist’s name and NPI

tours.title: Explain a balance / show the ledger
tours.q: How do I explain a balance (show the ledger)?
tours.what: Alt+L opens the active patient’s ledger with “Why this balance”: each visit’s charges, what insurance paid, adjustments and payments, so you can walk the patient through it.

steps.text: Press Alt+L: the ledger opens with "Why this balance", visit by visit

tours.title: Estimate what the patient will owe
tours.q: How do I estimate what the patient will owe?
tours.what: Shows what a procedure costs, what insurance should pay and what the patient pays — without charting anything.

steps.text: Press Alt+E: the chart opens with the cursor in the estimate box
Type "14 D2740": the fee, the insurance share and the patient’s share show — nothing is charted

tours.title: Verify insurance eligibility
tours.q: How do I verify insurance eligibility?
tours.what: Checks the patient’s coverage with the payer and updates the policy. Tomorrow’s patients are also checked overnight automatically.

steps.text: Press E: eligibility is checked with the payer and applied to the policy

tours.title: Book the next hygiene visit at checkout
tours.q: How do I book the next hygiene visit at checkout?
tours.what: At checkout the next cleaning is suggested with the patient’s hygienist, near the time of today’s visit. Enter books the first suggestion.

steps.text: Press R ("Book … recall"): the next open times with their hygienist, near the time of today’s visit, the first one focused
Press Enter: booked

tours.title: Send a task to a co-worker
tours.q: How do I send a task to a co-worker?
tours.what: Type “task …” in the command bar with @ and a name to give someone a task. It is about the active patient and due today unless you say otherwise.

steps.text: Press Ctrl/⌘K: the command bar opens
Type "task call the lab about the crown @jordan" and press Enter: assigned to Jordan, about the active patient, due today

expect.text: task call the lab about the crown @jordan

t.label: Find a patient (name, phone, birth date,

t.css: input[placeholder="Find a patient (name, phone, birth date, chart #), a screen or an action…"]
t.label: task call the lab about the crown @jordan

tours.title: Reschedule an appointment
tours.q: How do I reschedule an appointment?
tours.what: M picks the selected visit up; the arrow keys move it; Enter puts it down. Shift+→ keeps the same time on the next day.

steps.text: Press M: the visit lifts off the schedule
Press Shift+→: same time the next day
Press Enter: moved (Undo shows)

tours.title: Add x-rays or photos to the chart
tours.q: How do I add x-rays or photos to the chart?
tours.what: Add pictures from the computer to the chart. Each file is filed as a photo or an x-ray from the file itself.

steps.text: Press U and choose the two pictures in the file picker: added, each filed as photo or x-ray from the file itself

tours.title: Update medical history (add an allergy or medication)
tours.q: How do I update medical history?
tours.what: Opens the medical history on the Allergies line (A) or the Medications line (Shift+M). Saving also counts as today’s review.

steps.text: Press A: the medical history editor opens on the Allergies line
Type the allergy and press Ctrl/⌘+Enter: saved (and counted as today’s review)

tours.title: Record blood pressure and pulse
tours.q: How do I record blood pressure and pulse?
tours.what: Type the reading as it is said — “122/78 68” — and it is read back as BP and pulse before you save.

steps.text: Press V: one box opens under the medical history with the cursor in it
Type the reading as it’s said, "122/78 68" (it reads back BP 122/78 mmHg · pulse 68 bpm), and press Enter

tours.title: Mark a task done
tours.q: How do I mark a task done?
tours.what: To-do & labs lists your tasks; X marks the highlighted one done.

steps.text: To-do & labs: the task is highlighted at the top
Press X: done (Undo shows)

tours.title: Look up how much insurance benefit is left
tours.q: How do I look up how much insurance benefit is left?
tours.what: The Insurance tab shows the annual maximum, what has been used and what is left, and the deductible.

steps.text: Click the Insurance tab: annual maximum, used and remaining are shown

tours.title: Send a message in staff chat
tours.q: How do I send a message in staff chat?
tours.what: Team chat is the office’s own chat. Ctrl/⌘ J opens it on #Everyone with the cursor in the message box.

steps.text: Press Ctrl/⌘J: Team chat opens on #Everyone with the cursor in the message box
Type the message and press Enter: sent

tours.title: Call a patient who is due for recall
tours.q: How do I call a patient who is due for recall?
tours.what: Follow-up lists → Recall lists patients who are due or overdue, with their phone number. Book them from their row while you are on the phone.

steps.text: Follow-up → Recall: the most overdue patient is highlighted. Call them; they want to book. Press B: the booking panel opens on the first free time
Press Enter: booked (J / K move between patients, L logs a call instead)

tours.title: Build a treatment plan
tours.q: How do I build a treatment plan?
tours.what: N on the Treatment plans tab opens the plan builder. Type each piece of work and press Enter; Ctrl/⌘ Enter saves the plan and names it for you.

steps.text: Press N: the plan builder opens with the cursor in "Add work to the plan"
Type "14 D2740", Enter; "30 MO filling", Enter; "19 rct", Enter
Press Ctrl/⌘+Enter: the plan is saved and named for you

tours.title: Have the patient sign a consent form
tours.q: How do I have the patient sign a consent form?
tours.what: The right consent for the plan is chosen for you; the patient signs it on this screen (or on the iPad).

steps.text: Click "Consent" on the plan: the right consent is chosen, "Sign here on this device" has focus

t.css: div[data-plan="{plan}"] button[title="Informed consent for this plan's procedures"]
t.label: Consent…

steps.text: Press Enter: the consent opens for the patient to sign (no birth-date check)

t.css: button[title="Opens here for the patient — no birth date needed on this device"]
t.label: Sign here on this device

tours.title: Send forms to a patient before the visit
tours.q: How do I send forms to a patient before the visit?
tours.what: Sends the patient the forms they still need, by text or email, to fill in before they come.

steps.text: Messages & forms: click "Send forms…": the forms they still need are ticked
Click "Text/email to patient": sent

tours.title: Change an appointment's type, length or note
tours.q: How do I change an appointment's type, length or note?
tours.what: Click a visit to open its panel beside the schedule. Changes there save at once.

steps.text: Click the visit: its panel opens beside the schedule
Pick the new visit type in the panel: saved at once, its usual length follows (Undo shows)

tours.title: Present a treatment plan and get it signed
tours.q: How do I present a treatment plan and get it signed?
tours.what: Shows the plan to the patient on this screen for them to accept and sign — no birth-date check when you are with them.

steps.text: Click "Present here for {first} to sign" on the plan: it opens on this screen for the patient (same tab, no birth date)

t.css: div[data-plan="{plan}"] button[title="Opens the plan on this screen for {first} to read and sign (no birth date on this signed-in device; “Back to the chart” brings you back)"]
t.label: Present here for {first} to sign

tours.title: Update a phone number or email
tours.q: How do I update a phone number or email?
tours.what: E on the chart overview turns the mobile number into a box; type and press Enter.

steps.text: Press E: the mobile number becomes a box with the cursor in it
Type the new number and press Enter: saved (Undo shows)

tours.title: Chart perio (pocket depths and bleeding)
tours.q: How do I chart perio?
tours.what: Type the depths site by site; the cursor moves on by itself. B, U and P mark bleeding, pus or plaque on the site just probed.

steps.text: Click "Depths": the first site (#1 DB) is ready
Type 3 2 4, then B (bleeding on the last site)
Type 5 3 5, then Shift+B (bleeding on that whole side)
Click "Save exam"

tours.title: Review an online intake form
tours.q: How do I review an online intake form?
tours.what: Forms patients fill in online wait in “Sent in online” for someone to check. A merges what is new (allergies, medications, blood pressure) into the chart; nothing already on the chart is erased.

steps.text: Read what’s new (allergy, medication, blood pressure) and press A: merged into {first}’s chart (nothing on the chart is erased)

tours.title: Scan a new insurance card into a policy
tours.q: How do I scan a new insurance card into a policy?
tours.what: Take or choose a photo of the insurance card: it is read into the policy form for you to check, then saved and checked with the payer.

steps.text: Press S and choose the photo of the card: it is read into the policy form
Check what was read; press Enter: policy saved (and checked with the payer)

tours.title: Approve claims that are ready to send
tours.q: How do I approve claims that are ready to send?
tours.what: Claims prepared from finished work wait under Ready to approve, one row per patient. Approving one makes and sends the claim.

steps.text: Click "Ready to approve": claims prepared from finished work, one row per patient
Click "Approve" on the row: the claim is made and sent

tours.title: Work the Needs attention list
tours.q: How do I work the Needs attention list?
tours.what: Needs attention collects everything that went wrong in the background — a claim the payer rejected, a text that didn’t send, a payment that failed — so a person can fix it. Items clear themselves when a later attempt works.

steps.text: In the menu open Manage ▾ and click "Needs attention"

tours.title: Mark a recall call as "left a message"
tours.q: How do I mark a recall call as “left a message”?
tours.what: After calling a recall patient, log how it went so the rest of the team knows. “Left voicemail” is already picked.

steps.text: Recall: one row per patient, what they’re due for as chips. Click "Log call" on their row: it opens under the row, "Left voicemail" picked, Save focused
Press Enter: logged for the whole team, and all their recalls are marked contacted

tours.title: Log a phone call with a patient
tours.q: How do I log a phone call with a patient?
tours.what: Alt+G opens “Log a call” beside whatever you are doing, already filled in: we called, spoke with them, just now, about the active patient. Type what was said and press Enter.

steps.text: Press Alt+G: "Log a call" opens beside the screen — we called, spoke with them, just now, with the patient — the cursor in the note
Type what was said and press Enter: it’s on the chart’s call history (Messages & forms → Calls)

expect.text: Asked about Saturday hours; will call back

tours.title: Cancel an appointment (with a reason, and rebook)
tours.q: How do I cancel an appointment?
tours.what: X cancels the selected visit. Pick the reason with its number; the next opening then shows with “Book it” ready, so you can rebook while the patient is on the phone.

steps.text: Press X: the reasons list opens
Press 2 ("schedule conflict"): cancelled, and the next opening shows on the schedule with Book it ready
Press Enter: rebooked

tours.title: Set up a new patient (with insurance)
tours.q: How do I set up a new patient?
tours.what: Type the whole new patient on one line — name, birth date, phone, email, insurance and member ID — and press Enter. The chart and the insurance policy are made together.

steps.text: Press Ctrl/⌘K and type "new patient"

t.css: input[placeholder="Find a patient (name, phone, birth date, chart #), a screen or an action…"]
t.label: Find a patient (name, phone, birth date,

steps.text: Press Enter: the one-line new patient box opens

t.css: input[placeholder="Find a patient (name, phone, birth date, chart #), a screen or an action…"]
t.label: new patient

steps.text: Type name, birth date, phone, email, insurance and member ID on one line; press Enter: chart and policy made

tours.title: Call a patient about unscheduled treatment
tours.q: How do I call a patient about unscheduled treatment?
tours.what: Patients with treatment that was planned but never booked are listed under Follow-up lists → Unscheduled treatment. Log each call on their row.

steps.text: Follow-up → Unscheduled treatment: click "Log call" on their row (it opens under the row)
Press 5 ("Spoke — will call back") and Enter: saved

tours.title: Clock in
tours.q: How do I clock in?
tours.what: The time clock records your hours for payroll. I clocks you in.

steps.text: Time clock: press I — clocked in

tours.title: Write a prescription
tours.q: How do I write a prescription?
tours.what: The Rx tab lists your favorite prescriptions with numbers. Press the number to fill one in, then Enter to save it (and print or send it).

steps.text: Press 1: the first favorite prescription fills in, the Save button has focus
Press Enter: saved (and printed or sent)

tours.title: Post an insurance payment from an ERA
tours.q: How do I post an insurance payment from an ERA?
tours.what: Electronic insurance payments (ERAs) are posted automatically when they match. Insurance autopilot shows only what needs a person — for example a denial — highlighted.

steps.text: Insurance autopilot: clean payments posted on their own; the denial waits, highlighted. Press B: bill the patient

tours.title: Post an adjustment or write-off
tours.q: How do I post an adjustment or write-off?
tours.what: A opens the adjustment line on the ledger with the cursor on the amount; the type you used last is remembered. Enter posts it with its reason.

steps.text: Press A: the adjustment line opens with the cursor on the amount (last type remembered)
Type the amount and press Enter: posted with its reason (Undo reverses it)

tours.title: Ask a patient for a review
tours.q: How do I ask a patient for a review?
tours.what: Alt+R texts the active patient a link asking how their visit went. Everyone rates first; happy patients are invited to post on Google, a patient with a complaint can tell the office privately, and every patient can always post a public review.

steps.text: Press Alt+R: the review request is texted

tours.title: Look up a claim's status
tours.q: How do I look up a claim's status?
tours.what: Type the claim number in the command bar (“#33” or “claim 33”): the claim opens with its status and history.

steps.text: Press Ctrl/⌘K and type the claim number as it is written ("#33"; "claim 33" works too)

t.css: input[placeholder="Find a patient (name, phone, birth date, chart #), a screen or an action…"]
t.label: Find a patient (name, phone, birth date,

steps.text: Press Enter on "Claim #…" (first): the claim with its status and history

t.css: input[placeholder="Find a patient (name, phone, birth date, chart #), a screen or an action…"]

tours.title: Record a caries risk assessment
tours.q: How do I record a caries risk assessment?
tours.what: The caries risk assessment (CAMBRA) is a checklist of risk and protective factors; saving works out the risk level and recall advice.

steps.text: Risk & education: click "Assess" under Caries risk (CAMBRA): the checklist of risk and protective factors
Tick the factors that apply (two here)
Click Save: the risk level is worked out and recorded

tours.title: Upload a scanned paper document
tours.q: How do I upload a scanned paper document?
tours.what: Add a scanned paper (a referral letter, an old record) to the chart’s documents.

steps.text: Documents & x-rays: press U and choose the scan (the file picker takes its name and Enter): filed on the chart

tours.title: Mark a no-show
tours.q: How do I mark a no-show?

steps.text: Press Shift+X: the reasons list opens
Press 6 ("couldn’t reach them"): marked no-show; the next opening shows on the schedule (nothing to close if not rebooking now)

tours.title: Post a paper EOB / insurance check
tours.q: How do I post a paper EOB / insurance check?
tours.what: Post an insurance check that came by mail: pick the carrier, type the check number and amount, and it is matched to the claims it pays.

steps.text: Billing → Insurance payments: click "Post an insurance check"
Pick the carrier: their open claims are listed, and the cursor moves to the check number
Type the check number, Enter; type the check amount: it is matched to the claim it pays (paid as expected)
Press Enter: posted to the claim (audited; a check posted twice is caught)

tours.title: Create a lab case

steps.text: To-do & labs: press L — a lab case for the active patient with the lab, the crown, the tooth and the dentist filled in; cursor on Shade
Type the shade and press Enter: case logged (Undo cancels it)

tours.title: Check in a case back from the lab
tours.q: How do I check in a case back from the lab?
tours.what: When a case comes back from the lab, check it in: G for “looks good”, P to note a problem. The visit’s card on the schedule turns green.

steps.text: Lab check-in: click the case that came back
Press G ("Looks good"): checked in, the visit’s card turns green

tours.title: Call an insurance company about an unpaid claim
tours.q: How do I call an insurance company about an unpaid claim?
tours.what: Insurance follow-up lists unpaid claims, the ones due a call first. L opens the call panel for the highlighted claim; pick the answer, type the reference, and the next follow-up date is set.

steps.text: Insurance follow-up: claims due a call first. Press L: the call panel opens for the highlighted claim
Press 1 ("In process"): the cursor moves to the call reference
Type the reference and press Enter: logged, next follow-up set, on to the next claim

tours.title: Put a patient on the ASAP list

tours.what: Put a patient who wants an earlier visit on the ASAP list; they will be offered any opening that fits.

steps.text: Click the visit: its panel opens
Click "Add to ASAP list": they’ll be offered any earlier opening

tours.title: Send a payment link by text
tours.q: How do I send a payment link by text?
tours.what: Text the patient a secure link to pay their balance by card. The amount they owe is filled in. It needs card payments connected (the demo office uses the processor’s sandbox).

steps.text: Ledger: click "Send card payment link": the amount they owe is filled in
Click "Create secure payment link": texted to the patient (the demo office’s card payments are the sandbox: the link opens its Pay my bill page)

tours.title: Review x-ray AI findings
tours.q: How do I review x-ray AI findings?

steps.text: Press Ctrl/⌘K, type "x-ray AI review", Enter

tours.title: File an office document (OSHA, policy)
tours.q: How do I file an office document?
tours.what: Office documents keeps the practice’s own papers — contracts, licences, OSHA and HIPAA policies. Its type is worked out from the file name.

steps.text: Office documents: press U and choose the file (its type is worked out from the name)

tours.title: Add a staff member's login
tours.q: How do I add a staff member's login?
tours.what: Invite a new team member: type their name and email and press Enter. They get an email with a link to choose their own password, and start as front desk.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Users & roles"
Type their name (the cursor is already in "Invite someone"), Tab, their email (they start as front desk)
Press Enter (Send invitation): they get an email with a link to choose their own password

tours.title: Build or schedule a custom report
tours.q: How do I build or schedule a custom report?
tours.what: The report builder makes your own report: pick what to report on, run it, then save it (and have it emailed on a schedule).

steps.text: Report builder: pick what to report on (procedures, completed are the defaults) and click Run
Click Save: a browser box asks for the report’s name

tours.title: Check that backups ran
tours.q: How do I check that backups ran?
tours.what: Shows when the last backups ran and whether they worked.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Backups"

tours.title: Look up who changed something (audit log)
tours.q: How do I look up who changed something?
tours.what: The audit log shows who changed what, when, and what it was before. Type a patient’s chart number to see every change to their chart.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Audit log"
Type the patient # (the cursor is already there): every change to their chart shows as you type

tours.title: Edit a note template
tours.q: How do I edit a note template?
tours.what: Write the template the way you want notes to start; its name comes from its first words unless you type one.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Note templates"
Type the template (the cursor is already in it; the name comes from its first words unless you type one)

expect.text: Crown seat rbshmg: crown #__ seated with __ cement. Occlusion checked. Floss passes contacts.

t.css: textarea[placeholder="Crown #__ seated with __ cement. Occlusion checked."]

steps.text: Press Ctrl/⌘+Enter: saved (it’s in the list)

t.css: textarea[placeholder="Crown #__ seated with __ cement. Occlusion checked."]

tours.title: Set up the team bonus
tours.q: How do I set up the team bonus?
tours.what: Set up a team bonus (for example a daily or weekly goal); the plan opens filled in. Then switch team bonuses on so the team sees its progress.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Team bonus"
Click "Set up" on "Daily or weekly goal bonus": the plan opens filled in (name, goal, amount)

t.css: article[aria-label="Daily or weekly goal bonus"] button
t.label: Set up

steps.text: Press Ctrl/⌘+Enter: the plan is saved
Tick "Team bonuses are off" → on: the team sees its progress

tours.title: Set up a perfect-day schedule template
tours.q: How do I set up a perfect-day schedule template?
tours.what: A perfect-day template keeps time on the schedule for the work you want (for example crown preps on Monday mornings). The block shows as a lane on the schedule.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Perfect day & late patients"
Click "New template": the first provider, Monday, and one block 8–10 AM are ready
Click "Crown prep" under the block: it’s kept for crowns (and named for them)
Click "Create template": the block shows as a lane on Mondays

tours.title: Add an appointment type
tours.q: How do I add an appointment type?
tours.what: Add a kind of visit with its usual length.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Appointment types"
Type the new appointment type: Name, Length (the cursor is already in the add line)
Press Enter: added (Undo on the toast)

tours.title: Add a procedure code
tours.q: How do I add a procedure code?
tours.what: Type the whole line — code, description, fee — and press Enter. The category follows from the code.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Procedure codes & fees"
Type the whole line in the add box — code, description, fee — and press Enter (the category follows the code)

tours.title: Change reminder and message settings
tours.q: How do I change reminder and message settings?
tours.what: Sets when reminders go out (for example a week before, then 1 or 2 days before) and the other message settings.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Messages & reviews"
Change the second reminder from "2 days" to "1 day" before the visit (the Save bar comes up)
Press Ctrl/⌘+S: saved

tours.title: Record a patient complaint or incident
tours.q: How do I record a patient complaint or incident?
tours.what: Record a complaint or incident about the active patient; a follow-up for the manager in a week is set and put on the owner’s to-do list.

steps.text: Manage → Compliance log: press N — the form opens about the active patient, follow-up to the manager in a week
Type what happened

expect.text: Upset about waiting 40 minutes past her appointment time

steps.text: Press Enter: recorded, and the follow-up is on the owner’s to-do list

tours.title: Log an exposure or sharps injury
tours.q: How do I log an exposure or sharps injury?
tours.what: Log a needle-stick or other exposure with the post-exposure checklist (“reported today” is already ticked).

steps.text: Compliance log → Exposure log: press N
Type who was exposed, Tab, how it happened

expect.text: Needlestick recapping the syringe after an inferior alveolar block

t.css: input[placeholder="e.g. Recapping the syringe after a block"]
t.label: How it happened

steps.text: Press Enter: logged with the post-exposure checklist (reported today is already ticked)

t.css: input[placeholder="e.g. Recapping the syringe after a block"]
t.label: Needlestick recapping the syringe after an inferior alveolar

tours.title: Track staff licenses, CPR and CE due dates
tours.q: How do I track staff licenses, CPR and CE due dates?
tours.what: Documents → Staff licences keeps everyone’s licence, CPR card, DEA, radiology permit and CE deadline on one screen, with how long is left. One line adds or renews one: a first name, what it is and the expiry date — “casey cpr 08/25/2028” (add “#12345” for a number). The person gets a to-do 60 days before it expires (90 for CE).

steps.text: Documents → Staff licences: type "casey cpr 08/25/2028" and press Enter: on their row, with a to-do for them 60 days before

tours.title: Write a letter to a patient from a template
tours.q: How do I write a letter to a patient from a template?
tours.what: Letters for the active patient are numbered: press the number to fill one in from the chart, Enter to print it (it is filed on the chart), M to email it.

steps.text: Family → Letters (for the active patient): press 1 — the welcome letter, filled in from the chart
Press Enter: filed in their documents (Letters) and opened to print

tours.title: Add a provider
tours.q: How do I add a provider?
tours.what: Add a dentist or hygienist so they can be booked and credited with production.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Providers"
Type the new provider: Name, Type (the cursor is already in the add line)
Press Enter: added (Undo on the toast)

tours.title: Add an operatory (chair)
tours.q: How do I add an operatory?
tours.what: Add a chair (operatory) so it shows as a column on the schedule.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Operatories"
Type the new chair: Name (the cursor is already in the add line)
Press Enter: added (Undo on the toast)

tours.title: Change my password
tours.q: How do I change my password?
tours.what: Change your own password: type the current one, then the new one (at least 10 characters).

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "My account"
Type the current password (the cursor is already there), Tab, the new one

tours.title: Record a HIPAA disclosure (accounting of disclosures)
tours.q: How do I record a HIPAA disclosure?
tours.what: Record that you gave a patient’s information to someone (a lawyer, another office…). It goes on the patient’s accounting of disclosures. The reason defaults to the last one used.

steps.text: Compliance log → Disclosures (the active patient is chosen): press N
Type who it went to, Tab, what was given (the reason defaults to the last one used)
Press Enter: recorded for the patient’s accounting of disclosures

tours.title: Print mailing labels
tours.q: How do I print mailing labels?
tours.what: Prints an Avery 5160 sheet of labels for everyone on the list.

steps.text: Follow-up → Recall: click "Mailing labels" — an Avery 5160 sheet for everyone listed opens to print

tours.title: Check the prescription monitoring program (PDMP) before an opioid
tours.q: How do I check the prescription monitoring program before an opioid?
tours.what: Before a controlled drug is prescribed, the state prescription monitoring program (PDMP) is checked; the result is saved with the prescription.

steps.text: Chart → Rx: press 7 (hydrocodone) — a controlled substance, so "Check the PDMP" comes first and has the focus
Press Enter: the state program answers (in the demo, the sandbox) and the result is shown
Press Enter: saved with the check on it, and opened to print

tours.title: Mark a patient deceased
tours.q: How do I mark a patient deceased?
tours.what: Mark a patient deceased from the Recall box on their chart. The chart becomes inactive, recall reminders, statements and messages stop, and any future visit is cancelled — with Undo on the notice. The record itself is kept.

steps.text: Chart overview → Recall: "Don’t recall…" → Deceased: chart inactive, recall, statements and messages stopped, the future visit cancelled — with Undo

tours.title: Set up an online booking link
tours.q: How do I set up an online booking link?
tours.what: Your online booking page, a button to paste into your website, a QR code, and “Add the Book button” for your Google listing.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Online booking links"
Click "Copy" beside the website button (one line to paste before </body>); the booking page link and its QR code are above

tours.title: Turn on two-step sign-in
tours.q: How do I turn on two-step sign-in?
tours.what: Two-step sign-in asks for a code from your phone as well as your password. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app and type the code it shows.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "My account"
Click "Set up authenticator app": a QR code to scan with the phone

tours.title: Connect an imaging bridge or integration
tours.q: How do I connect an imaging bridge or integration?
tours.what: The imaging bridge connects a chair-side computer’s imaging programs and x-ray sensor to Dental Machine. An administrator sets up each workstation once.

steps.text: Click Settings (bottom of the menu), then "Imaging bridges": with no workstation yet, the setup is open
Type the workstation’s name ("Op 2") and press Enter
Click DEXIS, then "Add workstation and download": the install package (with its key) downloads

t.css: button[title="Known: classic DEXIS reads the patient from a small INI-style 'info file' ([Patients] PN/LN/FN/BD/SX) passed with @<path>; this is how common PMS bridges drive it. Assumed: the exact key names, the MM/DD/YYYY date and the default C:\\DEXIS install folder."]

tours.title: Sell or redeem a gift certificate
tours.q: How do I sell or redeem a gift certificate?
tours.what: N on Gift certificates sells one: the buyer is the active patient and it is paid the way you usually take payments. Type the amount and press Enter; the code is shown with “Print the certificate”.

steps.text: Account → Gift certificates: press N — the buyer is the active patient, paid the way this person usually takes payments
Type the amount
Press Enter: sold — the code is shown with "Print the certificate"
